question: Who invaded India during the rule of Tughlaq Dynasty?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Timur**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Timur** invaded India during the rule of the Tughlaq Dynasty in 1398.
 
• He was a Turko-Mongol conqueror who founded the Timurid Empire in Persia and Central Asia.
